answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: a new identity must bridge to 12 distinct counterparties across 4 clusters for full rewards. Each paid task opens one bridge; repeat trades with the same partner merely echo one link, adding nothing, so the score reaches its zenith only across clusters. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 links at 8 credits each: 96,000 credits against a far smaller pool; an honest agent pays 96 once and keeps its full share.
